objective:
Find downloadable multilingual text corpora covering 99 Whisper languages + yue/minnan/wuyu, each with 50+ short standalone sentences.

Best candidates:
1. FLORES-200 (HuggingFace facebook/flores, 842 sentences in 200 langs)
2. Tatoeba sentences
3. OPUS-100
4. UDHR translations

Deliverable for each source: exact HF dataset name or URL, python loading code (datasets.load_dataset or urllib), how many of the 99 langs covered, format.
